name: CareTalk Health
desc:
Patient Support Specialist (Remote) | $17/hr | Inbound/Outbound, No Sales Expectations
Company: CareTalk Health
Industry: Telehealth / Virtual Medicare Advantage Care Coordination
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 Think of yourself as the friendly traffic controller for a virtual doctor's office. CareTalk runs Annual Wellness Visits for Medicare Advantage patients, and you're the first person a patient talks to. You'd call patients ahead of their scheduled visit to confirm they're ready, check their ID, walk through a few pre-visit questions, and make sure their audio and video actually work before they get handed off to the nurse and provider. Once the visit's ready to go, you notify the care team and keep an eye on multiple patients' visits at once so nothing falls through the cracks. You'll also take inbound calls from patients with questions about their appointment or basic tech troubleshooting. It's a mix of outbound calling, quick problem solving, and staying calm while juggling several patients' schedules at the same time.
assessment: YES-MUST have VALID ID to take assessment and interview
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: Not stated in posting.
Required Experience: Experience in a healthcare or customer service setting required. No clinical certification needed.
Preferred Experience: Experience in telehealth, a medical office, or remote care delivery. Familiarity with HIPAA and patient privacy regulations. Bilingual in English and Spanish (or another language) is a plus.
Required Skills:
Strong digital fluency navigating multiple platforms (Zoom, Teams, EHR/CRM tools)
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
Ability to multitask, prioritize, and stay calm in a fast-paced virtual environment
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone with healthcare or customer service experience who wants a genuine entry point into telehealth without needing a clinical certification
Someone who's naturally calm under pressure and good at juggling multiple moving pieces at once
Someone comfortable with both outbound calling (confirming appointments) and inbound support (answering patient questions)
A bilingual participant, since Spanish or another language is called out as a real plus
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone without any healthcare or customer service background, since that's a stated requirement
Anyone who can't meet the strict technical requirements below, especially the ethernet-only internet and 16 GB RAM minimum
Anyone uncomfortable being on camera at any point during a shift
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Patient intake and check-in
Telehealth coordination
Care team communication
Appointment confirmation
HIPAA awareness
Multi-platform navigation (Zoom, Teams, EHR)
Customer service
Healthcare support
Scheduling coordination
Virtual clinic operations
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 Application → Assessment → Phone screen → Final interview. Total time to hire averages 3 to 15 days.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your experience in a healthcare or customer service setting.
How do you stay organized and calm when you're coordinating multiple patients' schedules at once?
Walk us through how you'd handle a patient whose audio or video isn't working right before their visit.
What's your comfort level navigating multiple digital platforms like Zoom, Teams, or EHR systems at the same time?
How do you set a welcoming, trustworthy tone with a patient you've never met, over the phone?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $17/hr.
Shift: Full-time, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST (converted to 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM CST).
Benefits: Not detailed in this posting. This is a W2 full-time role, so standard employee benefits eligibility would typically apply, confirm directly.
Equipment Provided: Not specified in posting. Participant is responsible for meeting the technical requirements themselves: Windows or macOS computer (no Chromebooks, Linux, or smartphones), 16 GB RAM, Intel Core i5 or equivalent processor, wired headphones, a webcam, and hardwired ethernet internet at 100 Mbps download and 50 Mbps upload minimum.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated.
Drug Test: Not stated.
Notes: This is a genuinely solid entry-level healthcare option since it only asks for healthcare or customer service background, not a clinical certification, while still being real telehealth exposure. The tech requirements are strict (ethernet only, 16 GB RAM, wired headphones), so confirm a participant's home setup honestly before they apply since this is stricter than most entries in the database. CareTalk is hiring for multiple positions at once for this role, so there may be more openings available than a single posting suggests, worth mentioning to participants.
Career Pathway: Not stated directly in posting. Reasonable inferred path: Patient Support Specialist → Senior Patient Support Specialist → Care Coordination Team Lead → Clinical Operations Manager, though this is an estimate, not confirmed by CareTalk directly.
training: CareTalk offers a combination of hosted training sessions and access to self-paced training content designed to be completed at your convenience.
